title: Information transmission with quantum squeezed light
summary:
• Squeezed quantum states deliberately reduce noise below classical limits by redistributing it in accordance with Heisenberg’s uncertainty principle.
  • This packs far more distinguishable signal levels into optical interconnects than any classical modulation allows, directly boosting capacity
